name: NeRF MLP Architecture
definition: A multi-layer perceptron F_Theta that maps 5D coordinates (3D location x and viewing direction d) to volume density sigma and directional emitted color c.
summary: The NeRF MLP Architecture is a fully-connected neural network that maps 3D positions and viewing directions to density and color, uniquely handling view-dependent effects via a separate direction branch and positional encoding.
